hints.en: Say you met a friend on Saturday and saw a movie on Sunday.
hints.t: 토요일에 친구를 만났어요. 일요일에는 영화를 봤어요.

hints.en: Ask Minji what she did on the weekend.
Say you're going to have dinner with a friend this evening.
hints.t: 오늘 저녁에 친구랑 밥 먹을 거예요.

hints.en: Apologize and say you can't go tomorrow because you're busy.
Say that tomorrow you're going to meet a friend.
Ask Junho if he has ever been to Jeju Island.
